input.description: Who Are We? Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants. We help brands drive profitable growth by increasing guest frequency, growing digital sales, and reducing reliance on discounts. Most loyalty platforms work for guests who are already loyal. Thanx unifies loyalty, digital ordering, and marketing automation in one platform that turns first-time and casual guests into regulars, treating loyalty as a business outcome, not a program, and engaging across the entire guest base. Thanx has raised more than $30M from elite investors including M33 Growth, Ribbit Capital, and Sequoia Capital. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural “core behaviors” with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say “ Thanx ” Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually. Who Are You? You're a product marketer who owns outcomes, not output. You are naturally curious about customers and not-yet customers. You write well and fast, and you get real satisfaction out of turning a customer's results into something a salesperson, a CSM, or a prospect can immediately use. You've spent enough time in growth-stage B2B SaaS to know how companies like ours work: how sales cycles move, what CS teams need, why launches succeed or stall. You have run launches where you set the strategy, not just the deliverables, and you have built positioning that sales adopted because it worked, not because you told them to. You decide what matters and what doesn't. You hold a steady output of high-quality material, you figure things out when the path isn't obvious, and you notice a gap and fill it before anyone assigns it. You are equally comfortable briefing the exec team and sitting on a customer call taking notes. Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start. Position Overview Thanx ships a lot. That effort only matters if the market, our prospects, and our own customers understand it and adopt it. The range is wide: big agentic AI launches like our most recent, RecoveryAI; technical ones like Square ordering, where the value exists in the minutia; and everything in between. Each has a different goal, and you work backward from that goal rather than running the same playbook every time. That's this role. You own how the market understands what we build. You set launch strategy, own positioning and messaging for the surface areas you cover, and turn what our customers are doing into proof that makes the value obvious to prospects, customers, internal teams, and partners. You report to the VP of Marketing and operate as a peer to sales, CS, product, and partnerships leadership. You will lead cross-functional launch teams without formal authority over them, brief the exec team on what is and isn't landing in market, and make the call on what we do and don't invest in. How We Work With AI What Thanx gives you AI capability at Thanx is infrastructure, not a perk. You will be given the tools, the budget, and the working culture to get good at this quickly: Real token budgets. You will not be rationed on the tool you use to do your work. Keystone. Our homegrown connective tissue that puts company data and tooling into a queryable, natural-language format. The Grid. An internal site to host AI-built applications, reports, and tools that can be shared company-wide. A show-and-tell culture. People here demo what they have built, and it becomes something the rest of the company uses. Getting up the learning curve is a shared project, not a solo one. A growing library of tools we built ourselves. Marketing runs its own marketing calendar app, marketing dashboard, competitive intelligence hub, case study asset builder, and sales demo platform. You will add to it: build the tools that take repeatable work off your plate, and hold the output to a higher standard. What we expect from you You treat AI as a working partner. You know the output is only as good as the context you give it and the review you do afterward, and you invest time in both. You build or improve things other people use . When you solve a problem, you put in the extra effort to make the solution reusable, so nobody on your team has to solve it again. Then you do the harder part: make it good enough, and obvious enough, that using it beats going back to the old way. You do not wait to be assigned the work. You notice when a one-off request is really a recurring problem, and you decide it is worth solving before anyone asks you to. At review time, the question is not how much you used AI. It is what you built, who else is using it, and how your team works differently because of it. What it looks like in this role You build the tool that makes the content. Instead of just writing the case study, you also build what orchestrates the whole case study production process: one customer interview in, a dozen usable formats out, page drafts in Webflow, deck content, and social assets that don't wait on a designer. Sales and CS run it themselves rather than queuing behind you, and the test is whether what comes out is usable without review cycles. You find the stories in the product. You use our internal analytical AI tool, Sherlock, to investigate how customers actually run their business on Thanx , surfacing the learnings and outcomes that today only exist in our CSMs' heads. You turn those golden nuggets into externally facing content in days, not weeks. Gone are the days of long-form content that takes months to produce. You get content seen. You treat distribution as half the job. You keep trying formats until one breaks through: video, podcasts, live events, office hours, community forums, whatever gets the audience to show up, and you use AI to make the learning curve shorter and the output more fun. You know the market and the competitive landscape cold. You use AI to listen for and understand what competitors are shipping and what operators are actually dealing with - traffic softness, labor costs, delivery margins - and can explain how those connect to what we sell and how we are different. Key Responsibilities Positioning and messaging. Own product-level positioning and messaging for the platform areas you cover. Build the frameworks, get sales and CS to adopt them, and revise them as the market and the roadmap change. You are the person who decides how we talk about what we build, and the person who defends that choice when someone disagrees. Launch strategy and delivery. Own launches end to end: set the tier, define the goal, choose the tactics that fit that goal, run the cross-functional team, and report honestly on what worked. You decide what gets a full launch and what gets a release note, and you make that call based on business impact, not internal enthusiasm. Customer stories and proof. Own the proof library, not just the individual stories. Interview newly launched customers and the internal teams behind them, find the unique angle, and produce everything from short reference stories to full case studies with quotes, metrics, and narrative. Build the system that turns one interview into one-pagers, slides, use case documentation, and the proof that answers "show me someone doing this" and "when would I use this feature?" Know where the gaps in our proof are before sales tells you. Enablement for sales, CS, and partners. Own what those teams know and say about the platform. Build the training, the competitive positioning, and the objection handling, then measure whether it is being used and whether win rates moved. Work directly with sales and CS leadership on where the gaps are. Market and competitive command. Own our point of view on what competitors are shipping and what restaurant operators are actually dealing with. Bring that back into positioning, roadmap conversations, and exec discussions. Be the person the exec team asks when they want to know what is happening in market. External and in-product content. Keep a regular cadence of customer-win content for social and partner channels ("this brand launched this week, here's why it's interesting"), and apply a product marketing lens to the Help Center and in-dashboard content: embedded video, plus the context that explains why and when to use a feature, not just how it works. How We Will Know It's Working At six months: you have run at least one Tier-1 launch end to end, sales is using messaging you wrote, and you have published proof for customers who launched on your watch. At twelve months: positioning is largely owned by you, the exec team comes to you for market intel, and the systems you have built mean the next launch takes less of everyone's time than the last one. What We’re Looking For We don't believe in rigid requirements, but success in this role typically involves: 8+ years in B2B SaaS, including 5-7 years in product marketing, customer marketing, or a closely adjacent role. Ownership of at least one major product launch end to end, including the strategy and the tradeoffs, not just the deliverables. Positioning or messaging work that sales and CS actually adopted, and a clear account of how you got them to. A portfolio of written work you can walk us through, including case studies, product content, and enablement materials, and a clear sense of what it accomplished. Experience conducting customer interviews and finding the story inside them. Strong instincts for learning core personas, and for adapting the same material across prospects, customers, internal teams, and partners. A track record of working productively with sales and customer success, and of creating enablement content those teams actually used. Experience influencing cross-functional teams you don't manage, and presenting to executives. Comfort with video and multimedia formats, not just written content. Restaurant or hospitality technology experience is a plus. The creative team is currently focused on rebuilding their editing bench to raise both craft and speed, ensuring that every asset—from cold outreach to retargeting—maintains a "hook-first" approach while keeping the customer as the hero. What you will do Cut finished video ads to brief, ensuring a strong hook in the first second, tight pacing, captions, and sound design ready for immediate deployment on Meta. Quality and retention-focused editing is the #1 priority. Resize and reframe single concepts into multiple assets for different funnel stages (cold, consideration, retargeting) and placements (feed, reels, stories). Maintain high volume and speed, managing reliable turnaround times and handling revision rounds efficiently within a fast-paced workflow. Apply motion graphics, subtitles, color correction, and simple animation to meet the client’s specific brand and quality standards. Produce a range of video content beyond paid ads, including organic social cuts, website/PDP videos, email clips, UGC edits, and localized/subtitled versions. What you bring Demonstrated ability to edit short-form DTC ads for paid social, shown through a reel featuring performed Meta ads rather than just montages or film-festival style work. Fluent proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or DaVinci Resolve), with strong skills in captioning, motion graphics, and sound design. Experience working at volume, demonstrating calm reliability and speed under a consistent, high-cadence production schedule. Must be comfortable handling ~30 concepts/month across multiple placements. Low-ego, brief-driven mindset with the ability to take direction clearly and iterate quickly based on feedback. Understanding of Meta-specific metrics such as hook rate and retention, prioritizing commercial effectiveness over artistic abstraction. Helpful, but not essential Mission fluency, particularly if you are Palestinian or have a genuine connection to the brand’s story and values. Ability to shoot video in addition to editing, allowing for greater versatility in content creation. Experience in other e-commerce verticals or direct-to-consumer brands with similar scaling needs. How the engagement works Contracting party: You will contract directly with Apricot, which will manage contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support. The role begins with a paid trial consisting of one or two cuts from real briefs to assess fit, followed by a continuing monthly contract. You are expected to provide your own laptop and basic equipment, maintain reliable connectivity, and follow required security controls. Planned check-ins are scheduled for month 1 and month 3 to see how the engagement is working and help address any issues. About Apricot Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients. Originally posted on Himalayas

input.description: HOW TO APPLY Click the "Apply" button above or follow this link to review and respond to our questionnaire: https://finsight-group.notion.site/17b0fc8b26fe81dfb3a6c8c048e8f86a?pvs=105 *We only accept applications sent through our questionnaire form COMPANY OVERVIEW FINSIGHT (www.finsight.com) is a financial technology company that creates high-reliability software (as a service) providing unparalleled visibility with actionable insights into capital markets. We serve thousands of the leading institutional investors, investment banks and corporations across the globe. Every day, we set out to design innovative solutions, backed by fanatical support, that streamline critical workflows and enable our clients to leverage their most valuable data. Our applications streamline workflows that facilitate hundreds of billions of dollars worth of capital markets activity. We are headquartered in New York City with offices in Miami, London, Singapore, Kyiv, Hong Kong, and Manila. We are a friendly, close-knit team of motivated and open-minded individuals committed to personal development, solving real problems and delivering excellent products and services to our clients. Evercall (www.evercall.co) by FINSIGHT is a premium virtual events service that provides best-in-class execution backed by fanatical 24x7 support of high-profile telephonic and webinar conferences in capital markets and corporate finance. We specialize in financial services and have executed hundreds of global investor calls, earnings calls, analyst calls, corporate announcements and “town halls” for many of the largest corporations in the world. ROLE OVERVIEW As a Conference Event Coordinator at Evercall, you will be responsible for the seamless execution of virtual events for high-profile clients in capital markets and corporate finance. You will coordinate all aspects of the event, from planning to post-event analysis, ensuring best-in-class service throughout. We are looking for someone with a passion for live events, who thrives in dynamic environments, and enjoys bringing together all the elements that create a successful event experience. Responsibilities Event Planning and Logistics Book, build, and circulate event details for clients. Conduct dry runs and technical rehearsals with stakeholders. Manage communications with clients and the stakeholder team. Oversee and moderate live virtual events, including audio, video, and hybrid formats. Moderate Q&A sessions and facilitate content sharing (video playback, presentations, etc.). Ensure all aspects of the event run smoothly, including internal and external communications. Event Production Audio Events Operate and manage audio-only conferences, making key announcements and introducing speakers. Moderate and facilitate audio Q&A sessions, ensuring smooth transitions between participants. Ensure high-quality audio recording of events, and manage file capture for later replay or distribution. Edit and produce audio replays, ensuring clarity and professional sound quality. Video Events Set up and manage video conferencing tools, ensuring all visual elements (video playback, presentations, sizzle reels, etc.) run smoothly during the event. Monitor and facilitate video Q&A sessions, moderating participation from attendees. Oversee live video recording to capture the event for replay, ensuring both video and audio components are of the highest quality. Edit and produce video replays, including tasks like trimming, syncing audio, and ensuring professional presentation for on-demand viewing. Operational Support Collaborate with global Evercall teams in London, USA, Hong Kong, and the Philippines to ensure service excellence. Master our event toolsets, including Zoom Webinar, Teams Webinar, and Webex Webinar, ensuring optimal use during events. Troubleshoot issues with platform vendors as needed. Assist in pre-and-post event data entry and data verification. Support the training and onboarding of new hires. Assist in transcription verification. WHAT YOU BRING A Problem-Solver’s Mindset: You don’t just fix issues, you pursue them. You’re energized by diagnosing root causes, untangling complex situations, and ensuring no detail is overlooked. You stay composed under pressure and approach every challenge as a chance to improve outcomes. Performance-Driven: You take full ownership of your responsibilities and are motivated by doing excellent work. You’re the kind of person who steps up when needed, takes initiative, and supports the team with a can-do attitude. Self-Motivated & Goal-Oriented: You operate with a sense of purpose, stay focused on outcomes, and consistently move work forward without needing to be micromanaged. Clear & Confident Communicator: You communicate thoughtfully and professionally, whether you’re coordinating behind the scenes or presenting in front of clients or live audiences. Meticulous About Details: You understand how important accuracy is in live environments. You catch the small things others might miss and take pride in delivering polished, reliable work. Adaptable & Quick to Learn: You’re open to feedback, comfortable navigating change, and always looking for ways to grow your skills and expand your impact. Customer-Focused: You’re responsive, thoughtful, and take pride in delivering an excellent experience for clients and attendees; always going the extra mile to make things run smoothly. Technically Capable: You’re proficient in Excel and familiar with video/audio editing software. Experience with Zoom Webinar, Webex Webinar, or Teams Webinar is a plus, as is exposure to live production environments. Multilingual is a Plus: Fluency in French or German is an asset as we work with clients across regions. Experience Welcome, Drive Essential: Two years of experience in a fast-paced environment is preferred, but we’re open to recent graduates who demonstrate strong potential and a growth mindset. input.description: Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026. NASCAR seeks a talented professional to join in the position of Coordinator, Event Operations, based in our Homestead, Florida office. The Coordinator of Event Operations is a key role at Homestead-Miami Speedway (HMS), supporting the successful execution of major events and year-round operations. Primary responsibilities include assisting the Guest Services team during major events—most notably NASCAR weekend—while also managing track rentals, special events, and related client needs. Our goal is simple Give you everything you need to create your best work. Who We're Looking For You don't need a perfect resume. You don't need ten years of experience. What you do need is the mindset. We're looking for someone who: Loves creating content Is always trying to improve Takes pride in producing high quality work Has experience filming and editing videos Understands storytelling, pacing, lighting, composition, and audio Pays attention to the small details that most people miss Is dependable, organized, and takes ownership Brings ideas instead of waiting for instructions Wants honest feedback because they know it helps them grow Wants a career, not just another job Whether you edit in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut isn't what matters most. Your creativity and your willingness to keep getting better matter far more. Where This Can Lead This is the part we're most excited about. We're not looking for someone to stay in this role forever. You'll also have opportunities to learn from some of the best content creators in the industry because we believe growth never stops. Schedule Primarily Monday through Friday Occasional evenings or weekends for events or special productions Based in Miami, Florida Local travel throughout South Florida Compensation $20.00–$25.00 per hour (based on experience) Opportunities for career growth as our media department expands Before You Apply... The person who goes home and watches tutorials because they want to improve. The person who takes pride in every frame they shoot. The person who wants to help build something meaningful. If that's you, we'd love to meet you. To Apply Please send us Your resume Your portfolio, demo reel, or social media work A short note introducing yourself and telling us why this opportunity excites you Bonus: Include a link to the one video you're most proud of and tell us why you chose it. input.description: The Manager, Multimedia Content, Live Video Streaming & Programming will lead TelevisaUnivision Local Media's live video strategy and programming across YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging platforms. This role will lead a team responsible for live production, digital video, and social content, while overseeing programming strategy, content execution, audience growth, and monetization. The Manager will combine strong editorial judgment, digital expertise, and operational leadership to develop engaging, culturally relevant content that connects with Latino audiences across the U.S. ABOUT YOU: You are a dynamic digital media leader with a passion for live content, audience growth, and innovative storytelling. You thrive in fast-paced environments, know how to turn breaking moments into compelling digital programming, and bring strong editorial judgment and platform expertise. You are a hands-on people leader who can inspire a team, collaborate across functions, and use data and audience insights to continuously improve content and drive results. Experience engaging U.S. Latino audiences and a strong understanding of digital video platforms are highly valued. YOUR DAY-DAY: Strategy, Programming & Team Leadership Lead the Local Media live video and multimedia content strategy, aligning programming with audience growth, engagement, and monetization goals. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of social media editors, video producers, and livestreaming specialists, establishing clear priorities, workflows, and performance expectations. Develop and manage a dynamic programming calendar for digital-first live content and related Video on Demand (VOD) assets, adapting programming to breaking news, cultural moments, and audience interests. Monitor digital video trends, platform developments, audience insights, and competitive activity to continuously evolve programming and content strategy. Partner with editorial, marketing, PR, sales, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated content execution and cross-platform promotion. Live Content Production & Execution Oversee the production of compelling live programming, including breaking news, interviews, special events, community programming, and other original content. Establish rapid-response workflows and production capabilities to quickly activate live coverage around breaking news and high-priority stories. Ensure content is editorially sound, culturally relevant, visually engaging, and tailored to Latino audiences across the U.S. Build relationships with journalists, newsmakers, creators, and other talent to develop compelling programming and expand audience reach. Audience Growth & Platform Optimization Develop strategies to increase discoverability, viewer retention, engagement, and audience growth across platforms. Optimize titles, descriptions, thumbnails, SEO, metadata, calls-to-action, and other platform-specific elements to maximize performance. Incorporate cross-promotion within live streams through slates, lower-thirds, and calls-to-action that drive audiences to other Local Media content, digital products, and platforms. Establish and maintain community engagement and moderation standards that foster safe, inclusive, and active live audiences. Performance, Analytics & Monetization Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including concurrent viewers, watch time, engagement, audience growth, and monetization. Use performance data and audience insights to make programming decisions and continuously improve content strategy. Partner with video and social teams to maximize the value of live content by repurposing streams into short-form clips, reels, and long-form VOD content. Identify opportunities to increase revenue and monetization through programming, audience growth, partnerships, and platform capabilities. YOU HAVE: Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in digital video, live streaming, social media, digital programming, or multimedia content production. Strong knowledge of YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and other emerging video platforms, including platform-specific best practices. Strong understanding of audience development, content optimization, SEO, algorithms, and social engagement strategies. Experience developing and managing a programming calendar or content grid across multiple platforms. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news or media environment, including rapid-response coverage. Strong editorial judgment with the ability to identify compelling, culturally relevant content for Latino audiences. Experience using audience analytics and performance data to make programming and content decisions, including KPIs such as watch time, concurrent viewers, engagement, and audience growth. Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and productions simultaneously. Bilingual English/Spanish preferred, with strong understanding of U.S. Hispanic/Latino audiences and cultural trends. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Please note the national salary range listed in the job posting reflects the new hire salary range across levels and U.S. locations that would be applicable to the position. OUR BENEFITS: TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options. TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. input.description: Leveling the Fields is a programs-focused nonprofit dedicated to increasing the number of girls in sports, recognizing the strong correlation between sports participation and future leadership roles. We are committed to breaking down barriers and providing universal access to sports, regardless of financial constraints, geographical limitations, or lack of options. Through our EmpowerPlay and PlayFit programs, we aim to get more girls into sports, keep them engaged, and equip them with the tools needed to thrive as future leaders. EmpowerPlay The EmpowerPlay Program is a dynamic multi-sport after-school program aimed at empowering girls through athletics and is designed specifically for girls in 3rd through 5th grade. The program is run onsite at the elementary school. Over the nine weeks, participants learn the fundamentals of each sport while building teamwork and confidence. Our program is designed to foster self-acceptance, positive body image, and good sportsmanship through our unique empowerment journal. For girls in low-income areas, the program is offered at no cost to families. PlayFit The PlayFit Enrichment Program is a weekly add-on designed to complement existing after-school programs, offering a fun and engaging way for 3rd-5th grade girls to stay active and build confidence. The program focuses on a single sport, allowing participants to deepen their skills, and is available in a 6-week or 8-week format. With on-site coaching and equipment provided, PlayFit makes it easy for girls to explore sports and develop teamwork and leadership skills. Designed to be accessible for all, this program brings empowerment and physical activity directly to your after-school care. , Volunteer Role Video Editor Organization Leveling the Fields Reports to Marketing Chair Time Commitment 3 to 6 hours per week (flexible) Role Overview The Video Editor is responsible for turning raw photo and video footage from our programs into polished, short-form videos for social media, email, and fundraising. This role helps bring our programs to life through clear, engaging storytelling. This role will oversee YouTube content and/or social media videos. Key Responsibilities Edit short-form videos using provided footage (reels, clips, highlights) Create content optimized for social media and digital use Apply basic branding (logos, text overlays, music, pacing) Organize and export final assets to shared folders Collaborate with the Marketing Chair on priorities and deadlines Ideal Fit Comfortable editing video (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, Canva, or similar) Strong sense of pacing and storytelling Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to meet light weekly deadlines Passion for youth sports and community impact Why This Matters Your edits help showcase the confidence, growth, and joy happening on the field—and make our impact visible to supporters and partners.
